parameters.query:
with m as (select * from public.team_07_metrics_daily),
wk as (
  select to_char(date, 'IYYY-"W"IW') as week, min(date) as week_start, max(date) as week_end, count(*) as days,
    count(*) filter (where actual is not null) as days_with_actual,
    sum(actual) as actual, sum(forecast) as forecast, sum(previous_year) as previous_year,
    sum(forecast) filter (where actual is not null) as forecast_cmp,
    sum(previous_year) filter (where actual is not null) as previous_year_cmp,
    round(avg(occupancy), 4) as occupancy,
    count(*) filter (where quality_flag = 'red') as red_days,
    count(*) filter (where quality_flag = 'yellow') as yellow_days
  from m group by 1
),
wk2 as (
  select wk.*,
    case when days_with_actual > 0 then actual - forecast_cmp end as gap_fc,
    case when days_with_actual > 0 and forecast_cmp > 0 then round((actual - forecast_cmp)::numeric / forecast_cmp * 100, 1) end as gap_fc_pct,
    case when days_with_actual > 0 then actual - previous_year_cmp end as gap_py,
    case when days_with_actual > 0 and previous_year_cmp > 0 then round((actual - previous_year_cmp)::numeric / previous_year_cmp * 100, 1) end as gap_py_pct,
    forecast - previous_year as fc_vs_py,
    case when previous_year > 0 then round((forecast - previous_year)::numeric / previous_year * 100, 1) end as fc_vs_py_pct
  from wk
),
k as (
  select sum(actual) as actual, sum(forecast) as forecast, sum(previous_year) as previous_year, round(avg(occupancy), 4) as occupancy
  from m where date between '2025-11-24' and '2026-05-03'
),
kn as (
  select sum(forecast) as forecast, sum(previous_year) as previous_year
  from m where date between '2026-11-23' and '2027-04-04'
),
-- holidays expanded to one row per (market, region code, day); '*' = whole country
hx as (
  select h.market, trim(code) as code, d::date as day, h.type
  from public.team_07_holidays h
  cross join lateral unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(h.region, '*'), ',')) as code
  cross join lateral generate_series(h.start_date, h.end_date, interval '1 day') as d
  where h.type like 'school:%'
),
htot as (select market, greatest(count(distinct code) filter (where code <> '*'), 1) as total from hx group by 1),
hw as (
  select to_char(hx.day, 'IYYY-"W"IW') as week, hx.market,
    least(1, round((count(distinct (hx.day, hx.code)) filter (where hx.code <> '*')::numeric
       + count(distinct hx.day) filter (where hx.code = '*') * t.total) / (7 * t.total), 2)) as coverage,
    count(distinct hx.day) as days,
    array_agg(distinct regexp_replace(hx.type, '^school: ', '')) as names
  from hx join htot t using (market)
  group by 1, 2, t.total
),
pub as (
  select to_char(d::date, 'IYYY-"W"IW') as week,
    array_agg(distinct h.market || ': ' || regexp_replace(h.type, '^(public|easter): ', '')) as names
  from public.team_07_holidays h
  cross join lateral generate_series(h.start_date, h.end_date, interval '1 day') as d
  where h.type like 'public:%' or h.type like 'easter:%'
  group by 1
),
hol as (
  select w.week,
    coalesce((select json_object_agg(hw.market, json_build_object('coverage', hw.coverage, 'days', hw.days, 'names', hw.names))
              from hw where hw.week = w.week), '{}'::json) as markets,
    coalesce((select to_json(p.names) from pub p where p.week = w.week), '[]'::json) as public_holidays
  from wk w
),
ev as (
  select w.week, count(distinct e.name) as count,
    coalesce(json_agg(distinct jsonb_build_object('name', e.name, 'village', e.village, 'date', e.date)) filter (where e.top_event), '[]'::json) as top
  from wk w join public.team_07_events e on e.date <= w.week_end and e.end_date >= w.week_start
  group by 1
),
wx as (
  select w.week, round(sum(x.snowfall_cm), 1) as snowfall_cm, round(avg(x.temp_max), 1) as temp_max_avg,
    round(avg(x.temp_min), 1) as temp_min_avg, count(*) filter (where x.precip_mm >= 1) as wet_days, count(*) as days
  from wk w join public.team_07_weather_daily x on x.date between w.week_start and w.week_end
  group by 1
),
lt0 as (
  select week_start,
    coalesce(bookings_0_days_ahead, 0) as d0, coalesce(bookings_8_days_ahead, 0) as d8, coalesce(bookings_31_days_ahead, 0) as d31,
    coalesce(bookings_61_days_ahead, 0) as d61, coalesce(bookings_90_days_ahead, 0) as d90, coalesce(bookings_180_days_ahead, 0) as d180
  from public.team_07_lead_time
),
lt as (
  select s.season, sum(d0) as d0, sum(d8) as d8, sum(d31) as d31, sum(d61) as d61, sum(d90) as d90, sum(d180) as d180,
    sum(d0 + d8 + d31 + d61 + d90 + d180) as total
  from lt0 join (values ('Winter 2023/24', date '2023-11-27', date '2024-05-05'),
                        ('Winter 2024/25', date '2024-11-25', date '2025-05-04'),
                        ('Winter 2025/26', date '2025-11-24', date '2026-05-03')) as s(season, a, b)
    on lt0.week_start between s.a and s.b
  group by s.season
),
pi as (
  select date_trunc('week', r.date)::date as week_start, r.reg_id, max(r.region) as region, round(avg(r.index_value), 2) as idx
  from public.team_07_region_index r
  where r.date >= '2023-11-01'
  group by 1, 2
),
pw as (
  select week_start, json_object_agg(reg_id, idx) as values,
    (select 1 + count(*) from pi p2 where p2.week_start = pi.week_start and p2.idx > (select p3.idx from pi p3 where p3.week_start = pi.week_start and p3.reg_id = 'R54')) as rank_r54
  from pi group by week_start
)
select json_build_object(
  'generated_at', now(),
  'days', (select json_agg(row_to_json(m) order by m.date) from m),
  'weeks', (select json_agg(row_to_json(wk2) order by wk2.week_start) from wk2),
  'kpis', (select json_build_object(
      'season', 'Winter 2025/26 (24 Nov - 3 May)', 'actual', k.actual, 'forecast', k.forecast, 'previous_year', k.previous_year,
      'gap_fc', k.actual - k.forecast, 'gap_fc_pct', round((k.actual - k.forecast)::numeric / k.forecast * 100, 1),
      'gap_py', k.actual - k.previous_year, 'gap_py_pct', round((k.actual - k.previous_year)::numeric / k.previous_year * 100, 1),
      'occupancy_avg', k.occupancy,
      'free_beds_latest', (select json_build_object('date', b.date, 'beds', b.available_beds) from public.team_07_free_beds b where b.date <= current_date order by b.date desc limit 1),
      'next_season', (select json_build_object('season', 'Winter 2026/27 (23 Nov - 4 Apr)', 'forecast', kn.forecast, 'previous_year', kn.previous_year,
          'fc_vs_py', kn.forecast - kn.previous_year, 'fc_vs_py_pct', round((kn.forecast - kn.previous_year)::numeric / kn.previous_year * 100, 1)) from kn)
    ) from k),
  'quality', (select json_build_object('days', count(*), 'red_days', count(*) filter (where quality_flag = 'red'),
      'yellow_days', count(*) filter (where quality_flag = 'yellow'), 'green_days', count(*) filter (where quality_flag = 'green'),
      'last_actual', max(date) filter (where actual is not null),
      'red_list', (select json_agg(json_build_object('date', date, 'forecast', forecast, 'previous_year', previous_year, 'actual', actual, 'reason', 'forecast = 0') order by date) from m where quality_flag = 'red'),
      'yellow_list', (select json_agg(json_build_object('date', date, 'forecast', forecast, 'actual', actual, 'gap_fc_pct', gap_fc_pct, 'reason', 'actual differs from forecast by more than 40 %') order by date) from m where quality_flag = 'yellow')
    ) from m),
  'village_beds', (select json_agg(json_build_object('village', v.village, 'beds', v.beds, 'host_count', v.host_count) order by v.beds desc) from public.team_07_village_beds v),
  'holidays_by_week', (select json_object_agg(week, json_build_object('markets', markets, 'public', public_holidays)) from hol),
  'events_by_week', (select json_object_agg(week, json_build_object('count', count, 'top', top)) from ev),
  'weather_by_week', (select json_object_agg(week, json_build_object('snowfall_cm', snowfall_cm, 'temp_max_avg', temp_max_avg, 'temp_min_avg', temp_min_avg, 'wet_days', wet_days, 'days', days)) from wx),
  'lead_time', json_build_object(
      'buckets', json_build_array('0-7 days', '8-30 days', '31-60 days', '61-89 days', '90-179 days', '180+ days'),
      'seasons', (select json_agg(row_to_json(lt) order by lt.season) from lt),
      'weeks', (select json_agg(json_build_object('week_start', week_start, 'total', d0 + d8 + d31 + d61 + d90 + d180) order by week_start) from lt0)),
  'peers', json_build_object(
      'regions', (select json_agg(json_build_object('reg_id', reg_id, 'region', region) order by reg_id = 'R54' desc, region) from (select distinct reg_id, region from pi) r),
      'weeks', (select json_agg(json_build_object('week_start', week_start, 'values', values, 'rank_r54', rank_r54) order by week_start) from pw)),
  'sources', json_build_array('TVB Paznaun-Ischgl / Feratel', 'Contwise (CC-BY)', 'JOANNEUM Research regional index', 'OpenHolidays (ODbL)', 'Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0)')
) as result;
